typography.systemNote: the Short App type system is INTER-ONLY (all 24 text styles; there is no mono register in this design system)
typography.dataRule: tabular-nums (the Short App system is Inter-only; no mono register exists — if the Figma appears to show a mono face, flag it as a design question rather than importing a font the token set doesn't define)

audience: applicant-facing (the Short App application flow — fields, cards, actions) or portal/reviewer-facing (the Portal Specific set: StatusTracker, Action, UtilityButton). This selects which component families apply.

briefSchema.heading: Step position
briefSchema.hint: STEP n OF m · SECTION NAME (or "unknown — asked")

briefSchema.heading: Job to be done
briefSchema.hint: the applicant's goal on this step

briefSchema.heading: Data collected
briefSchema.hint: | field | type | required | format / placeholder | options source | — required-ness stated for EVERY field, including fields inside a conditional block

briefSchema.heading: States
briefSchema.hint: | state (empty / disabled / error / success / …) | trigger | what shows |

briefSchema.heading: Conditional logic
briefSchema.hint: | trigger | exact boundary rule | what reveals | required-ness of the revealed fields | — "less than 2 years" needs its arithmetic, not its phrase

briefSchema.heading: Validation rules
briefSchema.hint: | field | rule | message shown | when it fires | — every rule needs its message; a rule with no message is a copy gap

briefSchema.heading: Copy supplied
briefSchema.hint: | id | role | text | — list EVERY role explicitly or mark it "not supplied": title · description · field labels · placeholders (per shaped field) · sub-section labels · help text · button labels · error messages · empty-state text · legal/consent

stopTriggers.when: the step is none of the eight §2 archetypes (a table, a dashboard tile, a file upload…)

a progress bar or back control in the header, a sidebar/rail/tab strip, NEXT, an asterisk for required, a second typeface or monospace, a gray disabled primary, an overlay for detail, a confirmation page (§7 hands off to the portal)
loading state, conditional-reveal indent value, progress-bar track colour, roles-matrix label type, owner-row height on mobile
legal / consent copy is missing (never drafted)
